assessment: This study provides an interesting new insight into the synaptic disease mechanisms of tauopathies. The paper is based on a technically very rigorous dataset indicating that increased levels of soluble Tau impair pre-synaptic endocytosis and, consequently, neurotransmission by sequestering Dynamin-1 on microtubules. The findings are of major relevance for basic neuronal cell biology and translational neuroscience alike.
